full_judgment:
Hasan Foez Siddique, J:-This appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated 22.901.2002 bassed by the High Court Division in Criminal Misceliancous Case No. 306 of 2002 rejecting the application under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure for quashment of the proceeding of' C.P. Case No. 1052 01'2001 under section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act pending in the Court of Metropolitan Magistrate, Dhaka. 

 3. The Magistrate Cook cognizance of the offence. The appellant appeared in the case and got bail. Then he challenged the said proceeding filing application in the High Court Division under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure for quashing the proceeding. The High Court Division rejected the application. Thus, the appellant filed this appeal after getting leave. 

 (d) no Court shall take cognizance of any offence punishable under section 138 except upon a complaint, in writing, made by the payee or, as the case may be, the holder in que course of the cheque. 

 6. In the instant case, admittedly impugned cheque was issued in the name of Abu Khair Md. Shakhawat Ullah and the petition of complaint was filed by Md. Alamgir Alam. Section 141(a) provides that the Court shall take cognizance of the offence punishable under section 138 upon a complaint, in writing, made by the "payee" or, as the case may be, "the holder in due course of the cheque". Here, petition of complaint has neither been filed by the "payee" nor by the "holder in due course". Complainant is an outsider. He had no connection. With the instant transaction. He is not holder of the cheque for consideration and that the cheque was not transferred to him. That is, the statutory requirements as provided in section 138 and 141 of the Negotiable Instruments Act have not been complied with in respect of this case while filing the same. 

 9. Thus, the appeal is allowed. The judgment and order of the High Court Division is set aside and the proceeding of C.R. Case No. 1052 of 2011 pending in the Court of Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Dhaka is hereby quashed.
